svg.title: Panpipes E3 to E4, chamfer edge, sheet 1 of 3
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Panpipes, E3 to E4, chamfer edge, sheet 1 of 3: end wall, front plate, plug, wall. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves the plugs' places on the front plate and the bevel's line on the back, on the plates' outside faces, which lie face up. Then orange #ff8000 cuts the slots, and black #000000 frees the parts.
